Koru UX Design is a leading UX design agency specializing in HealthTech. We partner with clients to deliver user-centered design solutions that drive innovation and enhance user experiences. Our design teams work as an integrated extension of our client’s teams, deeply embedding ourselves into their processes to create seamless, impactful products.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Senior UX Researcher who thrives on complex problem spaces and is comfortable driving research in ambiguity. At Koru, your insights won’t just sit in reports—they’ll directly influence real enterprise products across healthcare, automation, and finance.

You’ll plan and execute end-to-end research studies, work closely with product owners, and help define experiences used by thousands of professionals in the US.

Location: Pune / Remote

Experience: 3–6 years

Type: Full-time

What You’ll Do
  • Own and lead UX research activities across discovery, concept validation, and usability phases

  • 3–6 years of hands-on UX research experience (not internships or academic)

  • Ability to handle open-ended, ambiguous briefs—you’re someone who finds ways to start and drive the process
  • Familiarity with creating journey maps, service blueprints, or ecosystem maps

Bonus Points If You Have

  • Opportunities for growth and continuous learning (LinkedIn learning & professional trainings).
  • Flexible working hours and remote options.
  • A collaborative and innovative team culture.

Koru UX Design is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

himalayas::hm_nvidia_senior-software-eng.title: Senior Software Engineer - Autonomous Vehicles
himalayas::hm_nvidia_senior-software-eng.description:
Categories: Developer, Software Engineer, Autonomous Vehicle Software Engineer, Embedded Software Engineer, C# Software Engineer, GPU Software Engineer

Self-driving cars need to know where the road goes, in real time, with no prior map to lean on.

Self-driving cars need to know where the road goes, in real time, with no prior map to lean on. We’re building the perception-based world model stack that makes this possible. It takes raw multi-sensor input and produces a live, accurate 3D model of lanes, boundaries, crosswalks, intersection topology, and traffic control semantics. It also fuses perception, map, and localization data into a consistent model of the driving environment that the rest of the driving stack depends on. You will join a team of world-class software engineers improving these algorithms. This is a software engineering role: algorithms are only as good as the software that runs them, so we need an engineer who obsesses over quality, performance, and architecture, and who can turn algorithmic ideas into safe, fast, maintainable code for production vehicles on NVIDIA DRIVE Orin and Thor. Your code will meet ASIL-B/D requirements and ship across L2++, L3, and L4 programs. What you’ll be doing: Build and own core online world model and context fusion software that runs in the car, from architecture through implementation to deployment. Write production C++ for real-time embedded systems, with a focus on correctness, determinism, and maintainability. Design software architecture, interfaces, and data flows that promote code reuse and clean boundaries across vehicle programs, while meeting CPU, memory, and latency budgets. Profile complex pipelines, find bottlenecks, and deliver measurable improvements in CPU utilization, memory usage, and end-to-end latency, backed by reproducible measurements on Orin and Thor. Develop benchmarks and performance regression tests that track improvements and prevent regressions. Use GPU parallelism (CUDA) where it helps to accelerate compute-heavy mapping components. Implement and integrate algorithmic solutions from the mapping team into NVIDIA ’s AV stack, working closely with algorithm engineers to understand and refine them while preserving behavior, output quality, and correctness. Develop to automotive safety standards (ASIL-B/D): apply strong static analysis, follow safety-oriented coding guidelines, and achieve 100% line and branch coverage with rigorous unit and integration tests. Build software that is robust to the varied conditions and failure modes of vehicles operating around the world. Contribute to code reviews and uphold the team’s quality and safety expectations. What we need to see: PhD with 1+ year, MS with 3+ years, or BS with 5+ years of relevant experience in Computer Science, Electrical or Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience. 5+ years of experience building robust, production-quality software 3+ years of professional modern C++ development, with a strong grasp of memory management, concurrency, and performance. Demonstrated ability to profile and optimize CPU utilization, memory consumption, and latency using profilers and benchmarks under representative workloads. Solid understanding of algorithms and data structures and their impact on performance. Experience designing software architecture and APIs for large, long-lived codebases. A quality-first, systematic approach to debugging and optimization: comfort with static analysis, unit testing, and high-coverage test strategies. Ability to work with algorithm developers and understand their work. Strong communication and analytical skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively across multiple teams. Autonomous and responsible, a strong team player who enjoys solving hard problems, with a passion for robotics and autonomous vehicles.
